if( diff(range(site.age)) <= 600)  next("Too short reconstruction range!")





#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# prepare the overall output of the local reconstructionn in order to do a spatial reconstructionn
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

depths.timeslice.id <- list( which(site.age <= 0), which(inside.range(site.age,c(5900,6100))), which(inside.range(site.age,c(18000,22000))), which(inside.range(site.age,c(115000,126000))) )
# if( length(unlist(depths.timeslice.id)) == 0 & sitename != "Lake Ohrid" ) next("No timeslice of interest available!")

lat <- core.data[[station_id]]$lat
lon <- core.data[[station_id]]$lon

# if ages are duplicated
if(any(duplicated(age))){
    age[which(duplicated(age))] <- age[which(duplicated(age))]+.5
}

load("../../../european_pollen_database/local_reconstr_all_epd/in/core_data_kinneret.rdata") 
depths <- core.data[[1]]$depth
ages.mean <- c()
for(j in 1:length(depths)) ages.mean[j] <- round(mean(Bacon.Age.d(depths[j])))
ages.500 <- seq(-500,130000,by=500)
ages.50 <- seq(-50,130000,by=50)

ages <- list( ages.mean, ages.50[inside.range(ages.50,range(ages.mean))], ages.500[inside.range(ages.500,range(ages.mean))] )

rho_depth_given_age_all <- list()
for(i in 1:length(ages)){
    rho_depth_given_age <- array(NA, dim = c(length(ages[[i]]), round( max(depths) - min(depths))+1 ))
    for(j in 1:length(ages[[i]])){
        rho_depth <- Bacon.d.Age(ages[[i]][j])
        if(length(rho_depth) <= 1) break()
        rho_depth_given_age_temp <- density(rho_depth, from = min(depths), to = max(depths), n = round( max(depths) - min(depths))+1 , na.rm = T)
        rho_depth_given_age_temp$y <- rho_depth_given_age_temp$y/sum(rho_depth_given_age_temp$y)
        rho_depth_given_age[j,] <- rho_depth_given_age_temp$y
    }
#     X11();image.plot(min(depths):max(depths),ages[[i]],t(rho_depth_given_age))
    rho_depth_given_age_all[[i]] <- rho_depth_given_age
}



#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

output <- list()
output$rho_depth_given_age  <- rho_depth_given_age_all
output$age  <- ages
output$depth  <- depths

save(output, file = "data/out/age_depth/rho_depth_given_age.rdata")

weights_formula: q[a,j] = rho[a,k[j]] / sum_l(rho[a,k[l]]); W[a,j] = 1e-9 if q[a,j]==0 else q[a,j]
pollen_formula: P'[j,t] = 1e-6 if P[j,t]==0 else P[j,t]; Y[a,t] = sum_j(W[a,j]*P'[j,t])
units: Historical bound Kinneret depths: cm; ages: cal a BP. W discrete, dimensionless. Y inherits P units; no new calibration or conversion.
supported_domain: Finite nonnegative matrices, explicit paired resolution lists, finite age vectors, already aligned unique increasing sampled depths with exact integer in-bounds offsets, positive selected row mass, finite product.
not_implemented: depth membership repair, standalone sorting and duplicate-depth deletion
NA/Inf propagation, missing-output fill and fractional-index truncation
